newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London firmer after Dow gains.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London firmer after Dow gains.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mildly firmer on Wednesday, prompted by sharp gains on Wall Street on Tuesday following Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat Humphrey-Hawkins testimony to the U.S. Congress, dealers said.
But dealers said Japanese stocks continued to be stuck in a narrow range as investors had little incentive to open new positions.
"The market is very lacklustre," said one dealer, "I think people are still concerned over dollar weakness and the slow resolution of recent scandals in the banking sector."
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index gained 5.31 points to close at 1,658.41 after profit-taking and arbitrage linked selling in Tokyo forced the Nikkei 225 to fall 26.51 points to finish at 20,130.51.
Shares in Sony Corporation gained 85 yen to 10,785 yen, dragged higher by the recent strong performance amongst blue chips in New York.
Market watchers added the summer holiday season for investors and brokers in London was underway which exacerbated the quiet trading conditions.
